versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the tmall-hot-trend skill.
- Enables summary and comparison of brand flagship store and product page data on Tmall (price, reviews, sales).
- Supports lightweight, manual-triggered analysis of public pages only; ordering and bypassing security are not provided.
- Use cases include product lists, price/feature summaries, and simple product comparisons.
- Adheres to Tmall platform rules and strictly avoids batch scraping or violating usage policies.
